description:
src/cache.rs:265-301: `InMemoryCache::get_crl` / `get_ocsp` call `is_live(entry.next_update, SystemTime::now())` to decide expiry. But `HttpCrlFetcher::now_unix` / `HttpOcspFetcher::now_unix` are caller-supplied UNIX-epoch seconds for the validation time. The two time sources are not synchronized.

Trigger: any caller using a non-wall-clock validation time — e.g. backdated path validation (audit replay, attestation, offline / archived chain validation), forward-dated testing, or hostile-clock environments — will see incoherent behaviour. Concretely: (a) caller passes now_unix in the past so the validator should accept a cached CRL whose nextUpdate is in the past relative to wall-clock — InMemoryCache evicts it (returns None) and forces a refetch every call; or worse (b) caller passes now_unix in the future, the validator should reject a cached CRL whose nextUpdate is in the past relative to its now_unix — InMemoryCache returns the cached entry as live because nextUpdate > SystemTime::now() still holds. The validator then accepts it.

Bad behavior: case (b) is a security-relevant correctness bug — the cache serves entries the validator's own clock considers stale. CrlChecker::new will re-evaluate the CRL validity window against now_unix and reject it as CrlExpired, so the failure surfaces; but only by accident, because CrlChecker happens to redo the freshness check. If a future refactor of CrlChecker drops the redundant freshness check (reasonable optimization since the cache 'should' have filtered), the cache becomes a correctness gap.

Fix: thread now_unix into the cache layer. Either pass it through RevocationCache::get_*(key, now_unix) (breaks the trait — minor pre-1.0), or move the is_live check out of the trait and into the wrapper's miss/hit handling.

Note: the rustdoc on RevocationCache::get_* says 'MUST return None for entries whose next_update is in the past' without naming a time source, so the trait itself is silent on this. The reference impl resolves it to SystemTime::now(); that resolution is the bug.
title: Cache freshness uses wall-clock SystemTime::now() while validator uses caller-supplied now_unix
